scope: Comprehensive 20 FR x 13 Screen x 7 Wave Traceability Matrix

screens.name: App Shell & Session Navigation
screens.purpose: Global context frame, workspace and matter switching, user identity display, and cross-cutting navigation state.

screens.name: Executive Control Room
screens.purpose: Executive triage dashboard displaying critical blockers, Next Actions, Important Decisions, Waiting On, Milestones, and Evidence gaps.

screens.name: Operational Grid
screens.purpose: High-density multi-column workspace for browsing, filtering, sorting, and inline editing of Requirements and Actions.

screens.name: Requirement Detail & Lifecycle Drawer
screens.purpose: Inspection and lifecycle management for a legal/operational condition, including linked actions, criteria, and audit history.

screens.name: Action Detail & Assignment Drawer
screens.purpose: Operational execution panel for tracking discrete human tasks, internal assignees, waiting conditions, and upstream dependencies.

screens.name: Dependency Graph & Impact Inspector
screens.purpose: Visual and tabular representation of directed prerequisite edges, blocker chains, and causal impact analysis.

screens.name: Evidence Submission & Verification Drawer
screens.purpose: Proof submission, verification evaluation by designated independent verifiers, and dispute logging.

screens.name: Document Version & Signature History
screens.purpose: Awareness of document versions, authoritative promotion, and signatory completion tracking.

screens.name: Regulatory Filing Tracker & Package Manager
screens.purpose: Lifecycle tracking of regulatory submissions through draft, prepared, submitted, received, and final authority outcome.

screens.name: Bulk Metadata Editor & Preview Modal
screens.purpose: Controlled batch editing of approved metadata fields (owner, due date, description note) with per-row atomic auditing.

screens.name: Structured Import Wizard
screens.purpose: 3-stage import pipeline (Upload -> Schema/Validation Preview -> Transactional Commit) with duplicate and cycle detection.

screens.name: Delta Status Brief Generator & Viewer
screens.purpose: Deterministic delta report generator contrasting changes in (t1, t2] with outstanding status at t2.

screens.name: Scoped Event History & Audit Ledger
screens.purpose: Append-only immutable timeline of domain state mutations, administrative decisions, and access events.

requirements.title: Requirement vs Action Distinction
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Requirement & Action domain entities; distinct type descriptors; separate tables/endpoints
requirements.invariant_statement: Finishing an Action NEVER implicitly verifies a Requirement. Requirement has criteria; Action has operational assignees.

requirements.title: Milestones Tracking & Roll-Up
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Milestone entity; explicit required-prerequisite edge sets; rollup evaluation engine
requirements.invariant_statement: Zero percentage readiness displayed. Readiness is evaluated as satisfied/total counts plus explicit blocker list under RULE-008.

requirements.title: Next Action Queue & Deterministic Priority
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Action query filtering (assigned, NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS, dependency: READY); critical chain flag; sorting engine
requirements.invariant_statement: RULE-021: Next Action candidates must be assigned, active, and dependency READY. At Atlas T0, exactly 0 qualify; explicit reason rendered.

requirements.title: Waiting On Queue & External Dependencies
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Action with execution: WAITING; explicit waiting_party, waiting_condition, and internal_owner
requirements.invariant_statement: WAITING is an operational execution state requiring an internal accountable follow-up owner; it is distinct from dependency BLOCKED.

requirements.title: Prerequisite Dependencies and Blocker Logic
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Directed acyclic dependency edges; cycle validator; gate evaluator (execution completion vs proof-edge)
requirements.invariant_statement: Upstream edge satisfaction requires upstream READY + COMPLETED + (for proof-edge) VERIFIED with valid evidence. Self-edges and cycles rejected.

requirements.title: Evidence Requirements Specification
requirements.data_contract_dependency: EvidenceRequirement criteria model; validity period; version constraint descriptor
requirements.invariant_statement: Evidence Requirements define subject, acceptable proof types, and version semantics. Zero criteria does not mean automatically verified.

requirements.title: Evidence Verification & Designated Verifiers
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Evidence review command; verifier designation ledger; submitter-id check; dispute ledger

verify: EDITOR (must be matter-designated verifier and NOT submitter)

requirements.invariant_statement: Submitter cannot verify own proof. Only a matter-designated verifier who is not the submitter can accept/reject/resolve disputes under RULE-006.

requirements.title: Append-Only Event History Ledger
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Domain event audit store; immutable event log; causation_id and correlation_id; actor context
requirements.invariant_statement: All state changes produce append-only audit events recording actor, timestamp, prior/new values, and reason. No edit/delete of history.

requirements.title: Document Version Awareness & Authoritative State
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Document entity; DocumentVersion records; authoritative promotion transaction; sha256 checksum
requirements.invariant_statement: Uploading a new document version does NOT auto-promote it to authoritative. Promotion is an audited OWNER action with impact summary.

requirements.title: Document Signature Status Tracking
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Signatory slot entity; signature execution status; version binding
requirements.invariant_statement: Signature completeness tracks required signatories per version. Incomplete signatures cannot satisfy execution gates requiring signed docs.

requirements.title: Operational Views & Filter Presets
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Query filter coordinator; URL state sync; view preset schema
requirements.invariant_statement: Operational view presets (All, Blocked, My Actions, Due Soon, Critical) filter deterministically without modifying underlying data.

requirements.title: High-Density Operational Grid
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Paginated/virtualized Grid query; multi-column sorting; full-text search; inline edit mutation endpoint
requirements.invariant_statement: Comfortable default (min 44px) and Compact option (min 36px). Multiline rows expand; zero truncation of legal titles/reasons.

requirements.title: Bulk Metadata Editing & Validation
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Batch mutation endpoint; allowlist validator; atomic per-record result aggregator; revision guard
requirements.invariant_statement: Bulk edit restricted to metadata allowlist (owner, due date, description note). Per-record atomic results; partial success clearly reported.

requirements.title: Structured Import Pipeline
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Import parser; validation schema engine; duplicate detector; graph cycle checker; batch insert transaction
requirements.invariant_statement: Preview validates types, dates, references, and cycles before mutation. Imported verification claims are marked UNVERIFIED for review.

requirements.title: Scoped Excel Export & Security Controls
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Export stream generator; formula injection sanitizer; permission-scoped query filter; timezone formatter

export: VIEWER (scoped to active matter membership only)

requirements.invariant_statement: Exports escape formula-leading text (=, +, -, @) as literals. Excluded matters/records never leak in totals, filenames, or metadata.

requirements.title: Regulatory Filing Lifecycle Tracking
requirements.data_contract_dependency: RegulatoryFiling entity; stage transition validator; submission package assembler; external registry link
requirements.invariant_statement: Filing moves through DRAFT -> PREPARED -> SUBMITTED -> RECEIVED -> APPROVED/REJECTED. A filing receipt is NOT regulatory approval.

requirements.title: External Parties Contextual Association
requirements.data_contract_dependency: ExternalParty reference entity; contextual link table; no authentication credential
requirements.invariant_statement: External parties (e.g. Cedar Seller, Harbor Registry) are contextual references; they do not possess user accounts or permissions.

requirements.title: Simple Roles and Ownership Enforcement
requirements.data_contract_dependency: WorkspaceMember & MatterMember authorization tables; middleware role validator; 404 security responder
requirements.invariant_statement: Every operation requires active Workspace membership AND Matter membership AND role permission. Inaccessible matter yields 404, not 403.

requirements.title: Delta-Based Status Brief Drafting
requirements.data_contract_dependency: Event history windowed query engine; time-travel query at t2; delta calculator (t1, t2]; export formatter
requirements.invariant_statement: Status Brief evaluates baseline t1 and as-of t2 (t1 <= t2). Changes in (t1, t2] are strictly distinct from outstanding items at t2.

requirements.title: Separate Five State Dimensions Representation
requirements.data_contract_dependency: State model entities; separate typed columns/fields; discrete enumeration types
requirements.invariant_statement: Execution, Verification, Dependency, Timing, Attention must remain separate fields and UI badges. No single overloaded 'Status' string.
